title: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast audit test; exits non-zero on any failing pair with selector/state/theme/fg/bg/ratio/threshold named
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): the test entry point for US-207 (AC-207-1, AC-207-2). Reads `src/view/style.css`, calls `enumeratePairs(css)` from the helper, asserts zero failing pairs across both themes, and when `RCF_WRITE_CONTRAST_REPORT=1` is set writes a BEFORE/AFTER Markdown table to `./output/contrast-report.md` for the lane evidence. On any failure the message names each pair's selector, state, theme, foreground, background, computed ratio and applied threshold (AC-207-2). A second test asserts the pair-record shape so a future refactor cannot drop the structured fields the failure message reads from.
